data.corrects: docs/audits/2026-09-06-universal-triangulation-ep-route-assessment.md §3.4, which said identifying the per-atom closure is something 'the corpus does not currently do'. The per-atom WORD is computable and is a function of (Z,N).
data.scope: Distinct braid WORDS do not imply distinct CLOSURES (Markov moves, conjugation) and this probe performs no knot recognition and no hyperbolicity test. It establishes only that the per-atom object exists and depends on (Z,N) rather than A. Whether the closures are distinct links, and whether they are hyperbolic, are the next two open questions.
